channel.title: ScoreX Blog
channel.description: Guides to growing your influence score on X (Twitter).

item.title: What Is TwitterScore? How the Score Works and Why It Matters
item.description: TwitterScore rates an X (Twitter) account from 0 to 1000 by who follows it. Here is what the score measures, what it ignores, and why crypto teams check it.

item.title: How to Increase Your TwitterScore: 9 Things That Actually Move It
item.description: A practical guide to raising your TwitterScore: pick the right accounts, reply with substance, follow first, fix your profile and track what works.

item.title: Smart Followers on X: Who They Are and How to Earn Them
item.description: Smart followers are the notable accounts that follow you on X. Learn how to find them, why they matter for your score, and how to earn more of them.

item.title: How to Get Follow-Backs From Bigger Accounts on X
item.description: Why bigger accounts follow some repliers and ignore others, and a step-by-step routine for earning follow-backs on X without spamming.

item.title: The Reply Strategy: How Small Accounts Grow on X by Replying
item.description: Replies put a small account in front of a large audience. Here is how the reply strategy works on X, how many replies to write, and how to avoid looking like spam.

item.title: How to Write Replies That Authors Actually Answer (With Examples)
item.description: Six reply patterns that get answers on X, with before-and-after examples, plus the phrases that make a reply invisible.

item.title: Crypto Twitter Growth Guide for Small Accounts
item.description: How to grow on Crypto Twitter from a small account: pick a lane, find the right people, reply well, earn smart followers and avoid the traps.

item.title: Follower-to-Following Ratio: What It Tells You About Who Follows Back
item.description: An account's follower-to-following ratio is the best quick predictor of whether it will follow you back. How to read it, with examples and a simple rule.

item.title: Is Automating Replies on X Safe? Limits, Risks and Rules
item.description: An honest look at automating replies on X (Twitter): what X's rules say, what gets accounts limited, and the safeguards that reduce the risk.

item.title: AI Replies on X: How to Use AI Without Sounding Like a Bot
item.description: AI can draft X replies in seconds, and most of them sound like AI. How to brief it, what to ban, and how to keep your own voice.
